description: Defines the ReasonerContext class and getCurrentContext function for managing execution context in an AI agent framework, including dependencies on express, AIClient, MemoryInterface, Agent, WorkflowReporter, DidInterface, and ExecutionContext.

classes.name: ReasonerContext
classes.description: Represents the execution context for reasoning within an AI agent, encapsulating request details, identifiers, and interfaces for AI, memory, workflow, and DID.

methods.name: getCurrentContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current execution context as a ReasonerContext instance if available.

methods.name: ReasonerContext.ai
methods.description: Performs AI prompt generation, optionally with schema validation.

methods.name: ReasonerContext.aiStream
methods.description: Streams AI response for a given prompt.

methods.name: ReasonerContext.call
methods.description: Calls a target method on the agent with provided input.

methods.name: ReasonerContext.discover
methods.description: Performs discovery operation via the agent.

methods.name: ReasonerContext.note
methods.description: Logs a message with optional tags, associated with the current execution context.
